sources.name: Wild Wonders
sources.prompt: Create production-ready wall-mural artwork for a premium miniature toy-car boutique, NOT a picture of a room. Wide panoramic 4096 x 1024 composition. Reference style: richly detailed children's storybook / polished theme-park mural, rounded stylized forms, clean precise painted contours, layered scenery and gentle shading, bright turquoise, leafy greens, coral, golden yellow, lavender and blue, warm ivory sky. Full environments with believable buildings, paths, foliage and small activity; not isolated icons, not a row of symbols, not simple geometric clip art. Five environments flow left-to-right continuously with shared curved road/water/terrain. Keep focal buildings and important themed details in the middle 50% of the image height so the upper sky and lower foreground can be cropped for a very wide shop wall band; use quiet atmospheric sky above and low foreground terrain below. Scenic density high but larger shapes remain readable. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERING, NO NUMBERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARKS, NO frames, NO borders. No realistic people. Occasional small toy vehicles fit naturally into the setting. Opaque full-bleed art. The five environments must each be visibly present and connected, without dividing lines. CATEGORY 01 WILD WONDERS. From left to right: lush jungle with layered palm canopy, winding river and rope bridge, tiny safari jeep; warm red-barn working farm with pasture fences, vegetable plots and tractor; sunlit flowering apiary with several wooden beehives and bees among sunflowers; butterfly garden with flowering arches, winding paths, dense colorful flowers and varied butterflies; enchanting mushroom woodland with massive spotted mushroom houses, wooden doors, small creek and fern-covered roots. Cohesive continuous landscape, all five settings equally represented. Use the user's reference as aesthetic guidance, making substantially more detailed mural art.
sources.reformat: Edit this mural for a very shallow architectural wall band. Preserve the richly detailed storybook style and all five complete scenes (jungle, farm, apiary, butterfly garden, mushroom woodland), but RECOMPOSE them into an extremely wide low panorama. Output a 3:1 landscape canvas. The artwork itself occupies ONLY the middle horizontal one-third of the canvas height, making the artwork band a 9:1 panorama. Top and bottom thirds must be entirely plain solid warm ivory empty margin. ALL imagery, including full trees, rooflines, road, and foreground, must fit inside that central one-third band. Reduce object sizes to fit; do NOT simply crop the existing image. All five scenes should be equally wide and remain full environments, each with multiple related details. The center-band panorama must have straight horizontal edges at precisely one-third and two-thirds canvas height. NO text, logos, frame lines, or lettering. This is an image file layout for extracting the central band into a game texture.

Each of five settings must be a COMPLETE ENVIRONMENT with foreground, layered midground, backdrop, detailed buildings or landscape, supporting props, a little activity and occasional small toy vehicle. Do not stretch a normal image: compose tiny but richly detailed complete environments to fit this panoramic shape. All five complete scenes span the full canvas width equally; all rooflines, terrain and landmarks are contained in the center band. Straight horizontal band edges. sources.name: Connecting Landscapes
sources.prompt: Create a texture sheet containing exactly THREE equal-height horizontal panoramic environment strips stacked vertically, edge-to-edge, on a landscape 3:1 canvas (largest available resolution). Each strip is a 9:1 ultra-wide panorama. No margins, no labels, no text, no borders. Premium detailed colorful storybook toy-town mural style matching the previously generated detailed toy-world panoramas. These strips are connecting landscape scenery to extend murals; NO prominent buildings, characters, vehicles, hero props, rockets, ships or focal landmarks. Top strip: coastal landscape, sunlit turquoise sea, distant blue mountains, small rocky coves, soft clouds, palm groves at sparse intervals, low flowers and a sandy shore path along the bottom. Middle strip: magical cosmic landscape, distant purple alien hills, glowing rolling terrain, scattered rounded alien plants, soft blue star-filled sky, tiny far-off domes, a curving pale teal path along bottom. Bottom strip: storybook fantasy landscape, green river valley, distant misty mountains, small woodland trees, low shrubs and flowering meadow, old stone path following river at bottom. All three are richly painted natural connecting scenery, low contrast relative to main mural landmarks, moderate saturation, rounded stylized contours. Full images occupy the entire height of each strip; clear straight boundaries at exactly 1/3 and 2/3 canvas height. Never use blank paper margins.
